user.title: Connect to your HD-MD switcher
user.description: The switcher must be reachable on your network with its telnet console enabled (it is by default).

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the switcher. Check the IP address and make sure no other telnet session (e.g. PuTTY) is holding the console open.
error.unknown: Unexpected error — check the Home Assistant logs.

init.title: Name your inputs and outputs
init.description: These names appear in the source dropdowns and entity names.
